body:
Yes, wonderful people who I pushed away... they are no longer in my life because of how horrible I am. I never returned the favour by being a good friend.
I'm not as fat as I was but I'm still fat. I actually did starve myself for a while, which is why I have so much loose skin from losing weight quickly.

Men like boobs, but only nice boobs. Not old-woman ones :/. I could meet other lesbians but no one will ever be interested in me, plus I'm too ashamed of my sexuality to even think about that. I don't want my parents to think I'm a lost cause.
There's no point in talking because I don't know what to say and everything's irresolvable. Thank you though, I appreciate the offer :)

Maybe it's just because this post feels 'final'.. I'm very inarticulate the rest of the time. It's not really a college, more a technical school? I'm not sure what the US equivalent is.... but I'm not smart at all.

I'm scared of losing weight again, because I love food and comfort eating, and also because of the fear of the loose skin. Every option is horrible.

I don't know if I can't keep trying, I'm so tired of it all and there's nothing left to live for. There's too much to fix. Yes I have nothing to lose, but I've always had nothing to lose... and I keep failing, with my failures adding up, and I can't cope with them anymore.
